commands.command: targeted compatible organization creation store/HTTP tests with -race

verifiedBehavior: The GoodSentry organization-creation flag defaults false, accepts the GlitchTip alias and respects explicit GoodSentry precedence.
Disabled creation returns 403 before an organization write.
Owner/admin sessions and source-organization org:write Bearer credentials create an organization with one owner membership and default team atomically.
Member, read-only token, malformed-name/body, duplicate-slug and missing-authority cases fail without leaking broader authority.
The 201 OrganizationDetailSchema exposes the new owner access, no projects and the joined default team.
